proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.fixed_save_dc
proposed_widenings.justification: The magic-item activation shell, charge pool, dawn recharge, and last-charge destruction all fit, but the current spell-access surface can only cast the referenced spell using its normal resolution context. Wand of Web needs the cast to carry a fixed DC 13 instead of the wielder's spell save DC.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Web (save DC 13) from it.

notes: Did not author content/magic_item_wand_of_web.dhall because encoding this as ordinary grant_spell_access would incorrectly use Web's existing caster_spell_save_dc resolution. The item otherwise matches the existing magic-item activation pattern: 7-charge pool, dawn regain 1d6+1, attunement true, and last-charge d20 destruction on 1.
